subject: Proposed MAP & phased implementation timeline for Pioneer Analytics
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Rao <samira@pioneeranalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP & phased implementation timeline for Pioneer Analytics

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. I promised to send a compact mutual action plan (MAP) and a phased implementation timeline that aligns with the success metrics we discussed (search latency < 150ms, 95th pct availability SLA by M+2). Attached is a working MAP (Pioneer-MAP-v2.xlsx) and an initial SOW draft. High level notes below: 

- Kickoff target: week of Nov 15 (preferred) or Nov 22 (backup)
- Phase 1 (M0–M1): provisioning, data onboarding, model selection, test prompts — owners: Redwood infra (Ben), Pioneer data ops (Samira)
- Phase 2 (M1–M2): integration, latency tuning, cache profiles, initial acceptance tests — owners: Redwood SRE (Karthik), Pioneer eng lead
- Phase 3 (M3): production rollout, runbook handover to Pioneer ops, 30-day stabilization window — owners: Redwood CS (Marissa), Pioneer ops

Can you confirm the preferred kickoff week and whether procurement should be looped in now or at contract redline stage? If you prefer, we can convert the MAP into a one-page mutual action plan for exec sign-off.

I'll incorporate any date/owner changes and push an updated file before our next call.

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0112

Attachments: Pioneer-MAP-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), Pioneer-SOW-draft-2026-10-30.pdf (PDF)

From: Samira Rao <samira@pioneeranalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & phased implementation timeline for Pioneer Analytics

Grace —

Appreciate the clear plan and the fast turn. Nov 15 works for us as the preferred kickoff. Our eng lead (Arjun) is on PTO the week of Nov 8 so Nov 15 avoids that. We'll loop Procurement in once we have the SOW redlines — they generally need 7–10 business days to review pricing + security addenda. 

Two quick asks:
1) Can you add an explicit decision gate at the end of Phase 1 for model choice + quantization profile? We need that checkpoint to get internal sign-off.
2) Can you include a short list of required Pioneer artifacts for data onboarding (sample formats, S3 paths, retention policy)?

I'll review the MAP this afternoon and send any internal notes. I'll also cc procurement when I share the SOW redlines.

Thanks,
Samira Rao
Director of Product, Pioneer Analytics
samira@pioneeranalytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Pioneer MAP — operational notes & handoff items

Team —

Looping in Marissa for CS handoff coordination and Karthik for infra/runbook items. Quick internal notes based on Samira's reply: 

- Add Phase 1 decision gate for model + quant profile (action owner: Ben) — deliverable: decision memo + quantization test results by M+1 week 2
- Data onboarding checklist (action owner: Karthik): sample schemas, s3 sample path, retention policy, PII flags, mock dataset (10k rows). I'll add this to the MAP under "Required Pioneer Artifacts".
- Procurement timing: Samira signaled procurement only after SOW redlines. CS should prepare a short commercial appendix with recommended burst capacity for go-live to avoid surprises. (Marissa to own)
- Kickoff agenda draft: 1) Introductions & roles, 2) Environment provisioning, 3) Data onboarding walkthrough, 4) Acceptance criteria & decision gates, 5) Next steps.

I'll update the MAP with these bullets and push v3 to Grace. Marissa — can you prepare the CS transition checklist and a 30/60/90 day adoption milestones sheet? Prefer to have that before Nov 10 so Grace can include it in the vendor call.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Rao <samira@pioneeranalytics.com>, Pioneer Procurement <procurement@pioneeranalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP + SOW — kickoff week confirmed (Nov 15)

Hi Samira / Procurement team —

Per Samira's confirmation, we have Nov 15 as the kickoff week. Attached are: 
- Pioneer-MAP-v2.xlsx (updated with Phase 1 decision gate and required artifacts)
- Pioneer-SOW-draft-2026-10-30.pdf (same SOW; redlines welcome)
- CS-transition-checklist-v1.xlsx (30/60/90 milestones) — Ben and Marissa added handoff owners.

Proposed immediate milestones (short form):
- Nov 15 (Kickoff): environment provisioning, roles, data onboarding schedule
- Nov 16–Nov 30 (Provisioning & onboarding): provide sample datasets, grant read-only S3 access, initial model run on test dataset
- Dec 1–Dec 14 (Integration & tuning): latency tuning, KV/prefix cache setup, quantization trials, Phase 1 decision gate (deliverable: decision memo)
- Dec 15 (Acceptance): initial acceptance test results and sign-off for Phase 2 rollout planning

Requests for procurement: please confirm contract owner and preferred PO flow (if Pioneer uses PO numbers, we will attach an invoice template). If procurement prefers encrypted S3 for artifact transfer, let us know so we can include the right security addendum.

Next steps: Samira — when you have a moment, can you drop your team's preferred times for a 30-min kickoff slot the week of Nov 15? We'll send a calendar invite after procurement confirms any contract constraints.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

Attachments: Pioneer-MAP-v2.xlsx, Pioneer-SOW-draft-2026-10-30.pdf, CS-transition-checklist-v1.xlsx

From: Samira Rao <samira@pioneeranalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Pioneer Procurement <procurement@pioneeranalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + SOW — kickoff week confirmed (Nov 15)

Grace —

Nov 15 works; our team prefers morning slots (9:00–11:00 PT). Procurement (cc'd) — we'll start the SOW review internally and expect to send redlines by Nov 9. Procurement: our PO process is standard — we will issue a PO once commercial redlines are agreed and legal signs. Our security team prefers encrypted transfers; we'll include details in the procurement ticket.

Ben / Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the checklist — looks good. We'll prepare the sample data (anonymized) and share an S3 path by Nov 12. I'll add Arjun (Pioneer eng lead) to the kickoff invite once we lock a slot.

Samira
